correctness.rationale: Phase alignment reduces the radius to a concave positive-simplex functional. All maximizers are interior via fractional-power improvement at zero coordinates and are unique by geometric-mean equality rigidity. Alternating symmetry gives the unique t-root. The derivative at \(t=1\) has the asserted sign, explicit test vectors give algebraically exact strict lower bounds for p above and below 2, and the \(p=2\) symmetric-bipartite singular values are exact. Four-vs-two cyclic rotation enumeration exhausts all permutations; finite script checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: Determines the complete global optimizer/minimizer class for all six placements of a natural two-level weight multiset on the smallest cyclic configuration with two distinct orbits; sharp strict gap certificates work for every contrast and every non-Hilbert smooth \(\ell_p\). This resolves stability under coefficient arrangement beyond a local expansion and exposes nonlinear exponent-dependent geometry. It does not claim arbitrary graph or all-dimension rearrangements.
